reviews.text: Cutest pet store in existence and lovely owners!!
This is the best store I've ever been to in my life. You get greeted by 3 cute munchkins and the merchandise is incredible.

Thank you so much for your visit and kind review! 🐶💕
We hope to see you again soon. …

What a wonderful store! I came here specifically to buy gifts for my princess. I was greeted at the entrance by the furry little employees and the wonderful owner. 🩷 We picked out a dress and some treats, met the little ones, and left super happy!
Thank you so much 🩵 …

Updated review (Oct 2025): We visited the shop once again and were greeted by 2 cute dogs. The owner is very friendly and we were happy to re-visit during our trip to Tokyo. We bought treats which our dog absolutely loves. Thanks again!

Original review (Sep 2023): The shop dog was sooo cute and the owner is super friendly. Visit them you won’t regret it! Made our day! ☺️🐶
Good service and you can find exclusive toys
Super cute handmade puppy and poodle items! This place feels so warm and welcoming — perfect for anyone who has a puppy at home and loves to dress up their little cutie.
Cutest shop with the cutest owners !

Small but awesome little shop with excellent dog clothes, some toys, and some treats. The shop dogs are so cute and funny, and the owner is super nice. I definitely recommend making a stop here if you’re a dog lover in Harajuku!
